# Getting started

Run this project locally, in order.

## 1. Clone the repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/seanchatmangpt/frozen-duckdb.git
```

## 2. Change to the project directory

```bash
cd frozen-duckdb
```

## 3. Build the workspace (downloads the prebuilt binary on first run)

```bash
cargo build --workspace
```

## 4. Run the drop-in replacement example

```bash
cargo run --example dropin_replacement
```

## 5. Run the test suite

```bash
cargo test --workspace
```
